estimates.assumptions: 2 tbs chopped onion estimated at 20g (standard density for chopped raw onion; ~10g per tbs).
8 slices of bread; standard slice ~25g each for typical sandwich bread (total 200g), consistent with the supplied calorie density of 266 kcal/100g.
8 slices of tomato; medium tomato yields ~4 slices at ~15g per slice (total 120g), consistent with supplied calorie density of 22 kcal/100g for raw tomato.
4 slices mozzarella; standard slice ~28g each (total 112g). Typical part-skim mozzarella is ~300 kcal/100g; used this realistic value since field was null.
